provenance.units: RGB mean MSE, inherited original /3/N^4 normalization; no additional division

definitions.A: mean Re<T-P,P_m-P>; source field named cross
definitions.cross: -2A, signed contribution to net MSE cost
definitions.V: native MSE over the same all-non-DC frequencies
definitions.cost_db: 10 log10((mean V + mean D)/mean V), positive is harm; not mean per-image PSNR difference
definitions.h: 2(mu-1)/s, change in each of the two rel_cell coordinates; not vector norm
definitions.aggregation: Within each dataset, equal image and fixed-seed means, then equal model mean. Ratios use these pooled values.
definitions.ci: Percentile paired image bootstrap; each resampled image carries all models, seeds, scales and multipliers. Conditions on the two existing seeds.
definitions.ratio_warning: Ratios with denominator CI spanning zero are descriptive and unstable; use paired differences.

interpretation_limits: Retrospective saved-data comparison; no new training or model calls.
Matched per-axis h does not match native cell, LR features, local coordinates, or train support across scale; not a causal Jacobian isolation.
For positive matched steps, h at (2,1.3333) is 0.3333 and h at (6,2) is 1/3: end/start-1 = 0.0100010001 percent.
Positive matched start has native and perturbed scales in [1,4]; x6 native is out of range and perturbed effective scale 3 is in range.
Negative matched native scales 2,3,4 are in range; perturbed effective scales are 8/3,4.8,8, so latter two are out of range.
All quantities use original all-non-DC cropped frequency rows; not full-image or DC-inclusive benchmark MSE.
